title: Matter Side-Channel Message
description: A single side-channel message — the wire shape carried by `pact.matter.message` events (§24.8).

sender_principal.description: DID of the posting member. MUST be a current member of the Matter at the time of posting.

format.description: v0.1 supports `text` only. Future formats (`proposal-ref`, `obligation-ref`, etc.) extend without changing the envelope.

references.description: Optional cross-link to an attached fabric (and section within it).
